profile.headline: Junior Software Engineer @ Honeywell
profile.summary:
As a Junior Software Engineer, I've honed my expertise in designing full-stack web applications, enhancing workflow efficiency, and contributing to data management. My academic background in Computer Science and Mathematics from Texas Christian University laid a solid foundation for tackling complex software challenges. With proficiency in C# and Linux, I've successfully developed solutions that integrate seamlessly with our production databases, boosting job performance for engineers and managers alike.

My role extends beyond coding; it encompasses creating Power BI reports and interactive web applications that revolutionize data handling and minimize error risks. These contributions reflect my commitment to innovation and efficiency. Through collaboration, our team has empowered the engineering processes, ensuring that our software initiatives support and advance Honeywell's operational goals.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and deployed full-stack web applications using Blazor and .NET Core C#, facilitating improved job performance 
and management for engineers and managers by integrating with the production database
• Developed Power BI reports for operators and managers, providing real-time, refreshable data to support production flow 
and management in both wafer fab and sensor device fab environments
• Developed interactive web applications using ASP.NET to streamline data input and database integration, replacing the 
traditional Excel-based method. This significantly enhanced workflow efficiency for operator while minimize error risk

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Enhanced Python desktop application to facilitate efficient data retrieval from databases for the engineering team. 
Implemented a more user-friendly UI, expanded search functionality with additional keywords, and integrated compatibility 
with multiple databases featuring distinct schema 
• Collaborated with senior software engineer to optimize, debug, deploy, and document various legacy programs. Projects 
encompassed diverse areas such as database management, report generation, fabrication, and wafer program 
• Assumed responsibility for managing and documenting the Fab SQL server using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS). 
Streamlined server operations, ensuring smooth data handling and efficient query execution

positions.title: Network Security Course Assistant
positions.description: Prepared materials and programming assignments in Network Security class

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Researcher – Link: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/9391562	March 2019 – May 2022
•	Published paper IPCCC 2020 – “Paradox of AlphaZero: Strategic vs. Optimal Plays” 
•	Solved Go board game with a smaller board size (5x5 to 7x7) using the architecture of AlphaZero of Google’s DeepMind
•	Adapted and enhanced open-source code to enable neural network training specifically for smaller board sizes
•	Developed Python scripting tools for advanced analysis of output patterns, identifying optimal solutions on smaller Go sizes

positions.title: Python and Java Course Assistant
positions.description: Graded assignments/homework in Python and Java language classes

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
• Tutored students from all math courses taught at TCC
• Reviewed for student science-based courses from physics, and computer science department courses
